name: Daniel Hahn
description: Daniel Hahn , also known as Daytoner, is a concept artist based in Los Angeles. He specializes in creating futuristic designs, particularly robots and human-machine hybrids. His work combines elements of car design and character development, resulting in intricate and dynamic creations. Hahn employs a variety of techniques, including 3D modeling, digital painting, and photobashing, using tools like ZBrush, Photoshop, and Substance Painter.
